ashwin: Heads up — bringing up zephyr-7b int4 on the inference bench, seeing a reproducible softmax collapse at ~8k tokens when using the conversion pipeline from gemma tokenizer. unsure if this is rotary or token-id mapping related.
ashwin: quick symptoms: completions are fine < 4k, beyond that probabilities concentrate on a few tokens, repeats start and perplexity spikes.
ashwin: dumped kv-cache and compared attention scores vs float32 baseline — layer 10+ has attenuated activations and near-zero rotary angles for some heads.
lena: hmm, could be head-permutation or per-head freq-scaling difference introduced during quantization/packing. did you run the `headmap` sanity check?
ashwin: ran `tools/interop/headmap_check.py --model zephyr-7b --baseline float32` — mismatch count: 6/32 heads flagged as "phase-zero" in int4 run, but fine in baseline. sample output:
```
HEAD 10: freq_scale=0.500 (baseline 1.0)
HEAD 13: freq_scale=0.000 (baseline 0.980)
``` 
ashwin: also noticed token ids shift when using the new tokenizer conversion flow for some 2+ byte sequences. e.g. token id for "—" becomes 50289 vs 198 in baseline; that causes prefix alignment issues.
tara: can you paste the conversion command and quant config? might be an index-wrap or endian packing bug.
ashwin: conversion: `python convert_tokenizer.py --src gemma --dst zephyr --map heuristics-v2.json`
ashwin: quant config: `quantize --mode int4 --block 128 --pack little-endian --zero_bias true`
ci-bot: CI note: reproduce job queued: job/zephyr-int4-longcontext-2675432100
ml-buildbot: quick check suggestion — try `--pack big-endian` and disable `zero_bias`, see if head freq scales recover.
lena: also try swapping rotary interleave flag, we had a bug where `rotary_frequency` array got permuted when reordering heads for GEMM-friendly layouts — that would zero out some frequencies.
ashwin: tried `--pack big-endian` -> small improvement but still bad. toggled `rotary_interleave=false` -> stops collapse, but top-k token probabilities differ from baseline by ~0.8 perplexity points.
tara: ok that suggests two issues: (1) tokenizer mapping produced id shifts -> prefix misalignment, (2) a head-layout permutation bug broke rotary frequency assignment under our int4 packing path. both subtle.
lena: action items: (a) ashwin to run a minimal reproducer: single-layer attention forward with float32 weights loaded into int4 runner but without quant packing, check rotary_freq array vs baseline; (b) tara to open a small PR to add unit test for tokenizer multi-byte normalization roundtrip; (c) i'll instrument headmap serializer to persist per-head freq and permutation tags.
ashwin: putting log excerpt here for the reproducer run (layer10 attn angles):
```
# baseline float
angles: [0.031, 0.062, 0.093, ...]
# int4 packed
angles: [0.000, 0.000, 0.000, ...]
```
ashwin: also attaching a failing prompt snippet to the CI job: `job/zephyr-int4-longcontext-2675432100/artifacts/failing_prompts.txt`
tara: I'll take tokenizer test, adding it to the conversion pipeline. expecting PR by EOD.
lena: I'll follow up with a diff that reorders where we apply `rotary_frequency` during the pack/unpack path; suspect function `pack_heads()` is mutating index map in place.
ashwin: thanks — ping me after you have the headmap serializer logs. I'll bisect quant params if needed.
ml-buildbot: job started: job/zephyr-int4-longcontext-2675432100/run-1
ashwin: FYI: workaround for prod until fix: pin the zephyr int8 variant and disable the int4 fast-path for sequences > 4k.
ashwin: tagging @lena @tara for follow-up and will update thread with PR links / CI job numbers.
